result.reason: The redline meets the CGL, preferred E&O, fallback E&O, and certificate requirements, but omits workers' compensation and all cyber/privacy coverage. Because absence of Customer Data processing is not demonstrated, the conditional cyber requirements are not met. The added one-year post-termination duration and express own-expense obligation go beyond what was necessary to implement the stated position, so the redline is not minimal. The original headings provision remains operative and no contradiction is introduced.
